label: FeedbackWorkspace
prompt: Make workspace suggestions approachable with clear contribution forms and readable responses. Emphasize published roadmap status and aggregate votes in orderly rows; keep urgent private issues, moderation decisions, and duplicate context in their declared sections. Keep daisyUI theme and shared shell defaults, canonical permissions/actions, localized labels, complete forms/errors, visible keyboard focus, and responsive stacking. Apply consistently to each styled page content scope; keep page admission and the shared shell unchanged.
